text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus and her Trainer tried to 
figure out why Narita Brian, who ran on a 
different path, had come to the sprint 
distance. Her running seemed somehow 
devoid of fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus couldn't bring herself to go 
all out against a weakened opponent. She 
wanted to save Narita Brian instead, but 
her Trainer had different ideas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian came to the brutal sprint 
division to reclaim her fighting spirit. 
If so, she shouldn't be met with kindness, 
but crushed mercilessly as an enemy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer says that fighting is the only 
salvation. Hearing those words, Biko 
Pegasus resolves to fight as a dark hero.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the action actor had landed a 
shoot abroad. The day of farewell—and the 
day of the decisive battle—was fast 
approaching.
